title: Early release scheme could see dangerous criminals released, Conservatives warn
description: Nick Timothy's comments follow an announcement from the prime minister that some prisoners serving indefinite sentences could be freed to increase prison capacity.

title: US and Iran trade strikes for first time in weeks
description: The attack on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz - the first known US strike since late July - has killed two people and injured two others.

title: Dolly Parton laid to rest alongside husband in Nashville
description: A private family funeral is held for the singer who died on Tuesday at the age of 80.

title: Djokovic in tears during US Open first-round exit

title: The mystery of why so many black Britons still can't swim
description: For decades, swimming ability has been lower in the black community. Our writer asks why.

title: Patel to be replaced by Tugendhat as shadow foreign secretary
description: Kemi Badenoch is expected to carry out a wider reshuffle of her front bench team following high-profile departures.

title: Parents of seriously ill children should be entitled to 12 weeks paid leave, says commissioner
description: Children's commissioner Dame Rachel de Souza has backed called for more support for parents and carers.

title: 'Moonies' church leader jailed for two years over bribery offences
description: Han Hak-ja, 83, gave South Korea's former first lady two Chanel bags and a diamond necklace, a court found.

title: Russian strikes destroy 12 million books ahead of Ukraine's first week back at school
description: Ukraine says Russia is deliberately attacking its culture, after strikes on publishers and churches.
